metadata.title: Endpoint Threat Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting, containing, and responding to active threats on endpoints during runtime.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint detection and response agents, runtime monitoring engines, isolation mechanisms, and local response tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern defining runtime threat detection and containment on endpoints independent of baseline configuration or posture evaluation.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Threat protection operates only on endpoints that satisfy Endpoint Core trust requirements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint threat detection and response align with NIST Computer Security Incident Handling Guide.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Malware detection, prevention, and containment guidance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust assumes compromise and requires continuous runtime monitoring and containment.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Threat Protection defines how actively executing threats are detected and contained on endpoints. This pattern provides runtime defense-in-depth but does not replace configuration hardening, posture evaluation, or lifecycle governance.

components.title: Runtime Threat Detection
components.description: Detects malicious or suspicious activity occurring on the endpoint during operation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of malicious scripts or commands during runtime.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Behavioral monitoring detects active malicious behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: The endpoint monitors system activity to detect potential security incidents.

components.title: Runtime Threat Containment
components.description: Constrains or isolates the endpoint or processes to prevent spread or escalation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement or command-and-control following initial compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Containment measures prevent propagation and escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incident response includes containment of malicious activity.

components.title: Endpoint Isolation
components.description: Enforces network or system isolation of compromised endpoints during investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Remote service exploitation or lateral access expansion.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation controls restrict endpoint interaction with other systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection mechanisms restrict communication for compromised endpoints.

components.title: Threat Response Telemetry
components.description: Captures forensic and response telemetry to support investigation and coordinated response.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence following compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Telemetry preservation supports investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security-relevant events are analyzed to detect and respond to threats.
